title: Joint positions: all 20 episodes and executed references
caption: Absolute joint coordinates; shared endpoints and smooth motion should form a narrow bundle. No episode was removed.

title: Measured joint velocities: all 20 episodes
caption: Absolute joint coordinates; shared endpoints and smooth motion should form a narrow bundle. No episode was removed.

title: Joint position and velocity distributions
caption: Pooled observations, including lead-in and hold; dashed line is median. Peaks near zero velocity and endpoints are expected. Samples are temporally correlated, not independent trials.

title: Between-episode variation at the same motion phase
caption: Each motion is resampled to 121 points between A and B. Navy shows mean ± one population standard deviation across episodes; this is a descriptive spread, not a confidence interval.

title: Joint correlations
caption: Correlations reflect the shared A-to-B task and added perturbations; they do not establish causal dependence.

title: PCA of measured joint positions and velocities
caption: Each 7D dataset is mean-centered and analyzed separately by SVD without standardizing joints. Position PCA uses rad; velocity PCA uses rad/s. Motion phase colors reveal the dominant task trajectory.

title: PCA of combined position and velocity state
caption: All 14 features are standardized individually to zero mean and unit population SD before SVD, preventing radians and radians/second from being mixed directly. Low-variance joints receive equal weight after standardization.

title: PCA after subtracting the shared nominal A-to-B path
caption: Measured position minus analytical noise-free path, resampled to equal motion phases. These residuals include injected variation, controller bias, and tracking error. PCA is mean-centered, unscaled. This reveals variation hidden by the dominant common trajectory.

title: Motion and recording quality by episode
caption: Negative final timestamp differences confirm that recorded observations finish while the reference stream is still active. All seeds and all episodes are included.

title: RGB-D coverage, timing, and stream association
caption: Every depth frame and every video frame was read. RGB association compares decoded 160×120 thumbnails; small differences are expected because the two videos are encoded independently. Nonzero depth coverage is a validity check, not proof of metric accuracy.

title: Depth distributions across every recorded pixel
caption: Depth is uint16 millimeters aligned to color. Zero pixels are excluded here and reported separately. The exocentric camera sees a farther background than the wrist camera; distant returns alone are not considered corruption.

title: Proximity telemetry quality
caption: Sensor values are latest-packet sample-and-hold. Sensor update rates are slower than the 15 Hz policy clock; repeated readings are expected. Camera and robot validity do not imply high-rate proximity sensing.
